# OPERATOR NOTE: robots.txt is an honor system. If this site sits behind
# Cloudflare, "Block AI bots" / "AI Scrapers and Crawlers" must be OFF and
# Pay-Per-Crawl must be OFF, or these allowances are silently overridden at
# the edge. Do not challenge verified crawlers in the WAF.
